title: The Escalating Security Challenge of AI-Generated Code
summary: What I kept running into when reviewing code suggested by AI assistants — SQL built by concatenation, weak session handling, non-existent packages — and the review process I recommend before any of it reaches production.

title: A Comprehensive Framework for Vulnerability Propagation Analysis, Threat Classification, and Security-Integrated Pipeline Design
summary: Formalizes how one flaw in AI-generated code spreads through dependencies (GCVP), with a trust-weighted dependency graph, a propagation index (VPI) and a seven-stage secure generation pipeline. Simulated exposure fell from 0.47 to 0.083 on a 24-module app.

title: Ghost Jobs, Broken Code, and the AI Security Crisis Inside Canada's Public Sector
summary: A synthesis of public Canadian sources connecting ghost job postings, unapproved AI tools in the public service and fake job ads used for intelligence recruitment.

title: The Competence Gap: How Unskilled Use of AI Prompts, Agents, Skills and Code Generators Opens New Attack Surfaces in Software Systems
summary: Why the risk of AI tooling grows with the gap between how easy the tools are to use and how much the user understands what they produce.
